title: The Cybersecurity Dataset Observatory: Which Data for AI in Cybersecurity?
abstract: arXiv:2611.20812v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI is increasingly used for cybersecurity tasks such as intrusion and malware detection, in enterprise, industrial, vehicular and mobile networks. Its effectiveness depends on data: models need representative network traffic, both to be trained and to be evaluated realistically. Public datasets of cybersecurity network traffic, however, are scattered across laboratory pages, repositories and aggregators, and are continuously released, corrected and withdrawn: 92 of the 234 datasets we catalog were released in 2023 or later. At this pace, surveys that list them are outdated soon after publication, since they describe the field only as it was when they were written. We present the Cybersecurity dataset observatory, a public and continuously updated catalog of cybersecurity datasets based on network traffic. translated_title: 网络安全数据集观测站：AI在网络安全中需要哪些数据？
translated_abstract: AI在网络安全任务中的应用日益增多，例如企业、工业、车载和移动网络中的入侵检测和恶意软件检测。其有效性取决于数据：模型需要具有代表性的网络流量，以便进行训练并进行切合实际的评估。然而，网络安全网络流量的公开数据集分散在实验室页面、代码仓库和聚合平台中，并且不断被发布、修正和撤回：我们编目的234个数据集中有92个是2023年或之后发布的。以这样的速度，罗列这些数据集的综述文章在发表后很快就会过时，因为它们只描述了撰写时的领域状况。我们提出了网络安全数据集观测站，这是一个基于网络流量的网络安全数据集的公开且持续更新的目录。新数据集在被发现或提交时会随时添加，每条记录都会定期对照其原始来源进行重新核查……
tldr: 本文提出了网络安全数据集观测站，一个公开且持续更新的基于网络流量的网络安全数据集目录，解决了传统数据集综述因数据集频繁发布、修正和撤回而迅速过时的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the Cybersecurity Dataset Observatory, a public and continuously updated catalog of network-traffic-based cybersecurity datasets, addressing how traditional surveys quickly become outdated as datasets are frequently released, corrected, and withdrawn.
